The most significant improvement is to the work of Braverman [7] who proved a longstanding conjecture, showing that polylogarithmic independent distributions fool AC0 circuits. To be more precise, Braverman showed that any k-wise independent distribution, where k = O(log(m/ε))2d +7d+3 , ε-fools 2 circuits of size m and depth d.
